title: Future Plans: le Futur Simple
cefrDescriptors: Can describe plans, hopes and ambitions for the future.
Can use the futur proche and the futur simple for projects and predictions.
concept:
You already know one future from A1: the futur proche — aller + infinitive — for what's about to happen: Je vais chercher un travail. (I'm going to look for a job.) This unit adds the real future tense, the futur simple, which French uses for plans, promises and predictions: Je chercherai un travail. (I will look for a job.)

The good news: the futur simple is built on the INFINITIVE, and the endings are just avoir in disguise: -ai, -as, -a, -ons, -ez, -ont.
  parler → je parlerai, tu parleras, il parlera, nous parlerons, vous parlerez, ils parleront
  finir → je finirai… ; for -re verbs, drop the final e: prendre → je prendrai

A handful of very common verbs swap in an irregular stem — the endings never change:
  être → ser- (je serai)   avoir → aur- (j'aurai)   aller → ir- (j'irai)
  faire → fer- (je ferai)   venir → viendr- (je viendrai)   pouvoir → pourr- (je pourrai)

Which future do you choose? In everyday speech they overlap, but the feel differs:
  • futur proche = close, concrete, already decided: Ce soir, je vais réviser.
  • futur simple = plans, promises, predictions, distant horizons: Un jour, j'habiterai à Paris.

One trap English speakers fall into — after quand (when) talking about the future, French uses the FUTURE on both sides, not the present: Quand j'aurai un travail, je déménagerai. (When I have a job, I'll move.)

And the classic plan-maker, si + present → future: Si j'économise, je voyagerai. (If I save, I'll travel.)

The theme is les projets d'avenir: l'avenir (the future), un projet (a plan), un rêve (a dream), espérer (to hope), devenir (to become), déménager (to move house), économiser (to save money), plus tard (later on), bientôt (soon), dans un an (in a year).

Write three sentences about your own future: one with je vais + infinitive for this week, one with the futur simple for next year, and one starting with Quand… using two futures.
